name: Lalu Print - Main (print run, stuck check, staff actions, report link)

parameters.content:
# Lalu print automation (Phase 1)
One workflow, four flows:
**1 Print run** (daily 08:30 UK or manual) · **2 Stuck check** (every 15 min) · **3 Staff actions** (HubSpot webhook) · **4 Report link** (the print gateway calls this to fetch each PDF).
HubSpot is the only state store. Edit settings ONLY in the **Config** node. Reports are streamed from EMR+ to the gateway and never stored. See README.md for bindings. Activate only after the pilot checklist.

nodes.name: Staff action webhook
nodes.notes: Bind a Header Auth credential. HubSpot workflow "Send a webhook" sends header + body {"deal_id": "<Record ID>"}. Replies 200 immediately.

nodes.name: Report link webhook
nodes.notes: Called by the Cardiff print gateway, not by people. Public by design: every link is signed and expires. Use the PRODUCTION url (https://automation.lalu.co.uk/webhook/lalu-report).

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: ALL settings live here. Replace every REPLACE_ value: link_secret = a long random string (32+ characters). emr_base = EMR+ host (only the Report link flow uses it; leave the placeholder until you have it). emr_mode "dummy" serves clearly labelled dummy PDFs for testing; "live" fetches real reports.

parameters.content:
## 1. Print run
Printer ready? → read queue → resolve destination → claim (Preparing) → per destination batch (manifest + up to 24 reports): sign one link per PDF → one call to the print gateway → read each job result → write HubSpot. The gateway fetches each PDF from this workflow (flow 4), which streams it from EMR+. Nothing is stored. A timeout means "result unknown": never resent.

nodes.name: Printer status check
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential "Cardiff Print Agent": header X-Print-Agent-Token. Pre-flight before anything is claimed.

nodes.name: Printer ready?
nodes.notes: Online + spooler Running + printer Normal + right queue. Anything else => stop + alert email, nothing claimed.

nodes.name: Daily allowance
nodes.notes: max_reports_per_day minus reports already printed today. 0 left => run ends quietly.

nodes.name: Build batches and claim updates
nodes.notes: Invalid cases go to Needs attention with the reason; valid cases are claimed as Preparing, grouped by destination and split into calls of reports_per_call (max 24).

nodes.name: Build job links
nodes.notes: One item per print job: the manifest first, then each report. Each gets signed text.

nodes.name: Sign links
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 of each link with link_secret. The Report link flow checks it.

nodes.name: Submit to gateway
nodes.notes: NO retries here: a retry could print twice. A timeout can still print (seen in testing), so it is treated as "result unknown".

nodes.name: Print outcome
nodes.notes: Reads batchStatus and each job result / errorCode. Unknown or rejected => deals Needs attention and the run stops.

nodes.name: Build result updates
nodes.notes: Stage handoff only if the deal is still at an awaiting-printing stage right now.

parameters.content:
## 2. Stuck check (every 15 min)
A print run finishes inside one execution. If n8n restarted mid-run, deals can stay Preparing. After preparing_timeout_minutes they are set to Needs attention (hold on) so staff check the paper output. Never prints anything.

## 3. Staff actions
HubSpot sends the deal ID. n8n re-reads the deal, validates the request (note required, no active job, etc.) and updates it. Rejections are written to the Print request note as "REJECTED: ...". Print action is reset to None. Needs no printer call: the deal record is the source of truth.

## 4. Report link
The print gateway opens one link per job. We check the signature and expiry, then: manifest => build a plain PDF here; report => stream it from EMR+ (or a labelled dummy PDF in test mode). The PDF is never saved. Errors answer with a status code the print run turns into a readable reason (404 no case, 409 not completed, 403 EMR+ access, 410 expired, 422 bad link, 503 EMR+ unavailable/not configured).

nodes.name: Fetch report from EMR+
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER until EMR+ is ready: set emr_base in Config and bind a Header Auth credential (Name: Authorization, Value: Api-Key <key>). Streams the PDF back to the gateway; nothing is stored.
